definition: VoxForge is a free speech corpus and acoustic model repository for open source speech recognition engines.
details: VoxForge was set up to collect transcribed speech to create a free GPL speech corpus in order to be uses with open source speech recognition engines. The speech audio files will be 'compiled' into acoustic models for use with open source speech recognition engines such as Julius, ISIP, and Sphinx and HTK (note: HTK has distribution restrictions). VoxForge has used LibriVox as a source of audio data since 2007.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. Here is the short version: VoxForge is a free speech corpus and acoustic model repository for open source speech recognition engines. The part that makes it sing: VoxForge was set up to collect transcribed speech to create a free GPL speech corpus in order to be uses with open source speech recognition engines. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is VoxForge — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
